headline: Sacred Heart's winning run ends at Syracuse
dek: Sacred Heart won away at Fairfield, the table's leaders, and at Marist behind them, on a winning run that ended by the odd goal at Syracuse. It left them with nine wins, seven draws and six defeats, after a conference campaign in which they had drawn as often as they won.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals scored did not separate the leading sides: Quinnipiac scored as many as Fairfield and Marist, and conceded more than either.

wire.line: Fairfield lost four times all season, and Sacred Heart were the only side to do it on Fairfield's own ground.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Taehyeon Lim scored twelve goals for Quinnipiac from 41 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Merrimack drew nine of its matches, more than any other program in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Canisius conceded 37 goals, more than any other program in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Thirteen different players scored for Fairfield, none of them among the conference's leading scorers.

last_match.line: Sacred Heart arrived having beaten Fairfield, Niagara, Marist and Merrimack in succession.
